title: Publang Announces 5 New BL Manhwa, Web Novel Titles at Anime NYC
content: At its Anime NYC panel on Saturday, BL -focused publisher Publang announced five new titles, including three manhwa and two web novels. The new lineup includes the manhwa Define the Relationship , The Hunter's Gonna Lay Low , and PASSION , as well as the web novels Healer and The Hunter's Gonna Lay Low .
author: ANN

title: GKIDS Licenses Vampire Hunter D: Bloodlust Anime Film, Live-Action 5 Centimeters Per Second Film
content: GKIDS announced on Saturday it has acquired the North American rights to the Vampire Hunter D: Bloodlust anime film and the live-action film of Makoto Shinkai 's 5 Centimeters per Second anime film.
author: ANN

title: Cancelled Shonen Jump Series Returns With Final U.S. Release After Anime’s Success
content: Eight years after the manga cancellation, Black Torch became a fan-favorite series thanks to the anime debut this summer season. Written and illustrated by Tsuyoshi Takaki, the manga was serialized in Shueisha’s Jump Square magazine from 2016 to 2018.
author: ComicBook

title: Solo Leveling’s New Sequel Continues Jinwoo’s Journey Ahead of Anime’s Return
content: There’s still a while before the anime will return with the sequel film, but Solo Leveling continues to engage fans with new content even now. Thanks to the novel written by Chugong and the webtoon adaptation illustrated by DUBU, the anime’s debut was a massive hit worldwide.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Beloved Fantasy Creator Returns With New Look At Beloved Characters Ahead of Final Release
content: Crunchyroll is the largest streaming hub for anime fans across the globe, with more series in its library than one can count. Among the many fan-favorite series on the platform, one of them is Yona of the Dawn , a romance fantasy based on a critically acclaimed manga written and illustrated by Kusanagi Mizuho.
author: ComicBook

title: One Piece Anime Reveals Episode 1175 Preview
content: ONE PIECE revealed the preview for Episode 1175, showing the Straw Hats and giants reacting to the new threat that appeared. The anime returned after a 3-month break on April 5, with the crew reaching the giants’ Elbaph Island.
author: Anime Corner

title: Manga Mirai Service Shuts Down
content: Manga Mirai acknowledges that users "may be eligible for a refund" if MangaPlaza does not have the licenses for some titles Manga Mirai had, if the user is below MangaPlaza 's age limit of 18, or if the user opts out of transferring their account information to MangaPlaza .
author: ANN

title: Code Vein II Game's 'Mask of Idris' DLC Debuts on September 9
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment America revealed on Thursday that the new "Mask of Idris" DLC for Code Vein II , the sequel to the Code Vein post-apocalyptic role-playing game , will debut on September 9. The company began streaming a teaser trailer for the DLC on the same day.
author: ANN
